context_requirements: Expression of cannabinoid receptor CNR2 (CB2) or CNR1 (CB1) at sufficient levels
An intact G-protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway responsive to inverse agonism
Cellular context in which CNR2 has constitutive activity that can be reduced
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
A shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines that is absent in vehicle controls
Evidence of CNR2-mediated signaling changes (e.g., cAMP response) that correlate with transcriptional changes
